objective: Build an intelligent active-aerodynamics controller for 20–55 m/s operation. Evaluate NVIDIA DoMINO as the physics-based surrogate, establish a transparent reference, partition the system, define and optimize the architecture, and deliver the hardware, firmware, and software with bounded control, stale-data detection, timeout handling, and safe fallback.
